title: Visual Studio 2022 version 17.10.2
body_markdown:
*released June 11th, 2024*

### Summary of What's New in this Release

* Fixed an issue in which TypeScript errors might be shown in a Razor file when there are no errors in TypeScript for the file.
* After upgrading to Germanium build of Windows, WSL requires a manual upgrade. This can cause Visual Studio to hang when opening CMake projects.
* [VS now includes MAUI 8.0.40 (SR5)](https://github.com/dotnet/maui/releases/tag/8.0.40)
* Add an optional installer component for the recently released Windows SDK version 10.0.26100.
* The use of .NET SDK 7 caused issues when combined with Razor projects. <https://github.com/dotnet/razor/issues/10411>. *Note*: the .NET SDK 7 series is out of support. Customers previously hitting this should strongly consider moving to a .NET SDK which is in support.

### Developer Community

* [TS1109 (TS) Expression expected error in Razor file](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/TS1109-TS-Expression-expected-error-in/10635769)
* [cmdnameRunIntellisenseCheck leftover in Tools](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/cmdnameRunIntellisenseCheck-leftover-in-/10664043)
* [Cannot nuget restore after updating visual studio community to 17.10.0. An item with the same key has already been added.](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Cannot-nuget-restore-after-updating-visu/10665602)
* [Unable to debug x86 code on Sapphire Rapids CPUs in Visual Studio 2022](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Mixed-mode-debugging-of-C-CCLI-and-C/10517942)

### Security advisories addressed

* [**CVE-2024-30052**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2024-30052) Remote Code Execution when debugging dump files that contain a malicious file with an appropriate extension
* [**CVE-2024-29060**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2024-29060) Elevation of Privilege where affected installation of Visual Studio is running
* [**CVE-2024-29187**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2024-29187) WiX based installers are vulnerable to binary hijack when run as SYSTEM

---
